concerns.text: SC-001 (proportion of subjects successfully processed) is a mandatory success criterion in the spec, but no task records or verifies this proportion. T002 only checks that an exclusion log exists and that the number of retained time‑series matches the subject count, leaving the required proportion metric unmeasured.

FR-004 requires collapsing edge‑wise variability into a *single* subject‑level predictor variable. T003 replaces this with ten PCA components (PCA_Component_1 … PCA_Component_10) without explicit justification in the spec, effectively weakening the functional requirement by changing the definition of the predictor metric.
